claim_text: Netanyahu said senior security chiefs chose not to wake him before October 7 because they feared he would order a major alert and thereby trigger an exchange with Hamas; he added that if he had been awakened, the invasion would not have occurred.
discovery_sources: Channel 14 / The Patriots interview; Times of Israel reconstruction; Ynet/PMO chronology; Shin Bet affidavit reporting; ICE interview identification; PMO chronology republished by Channel 14 2026-09-04; Channel 12/Kan follow-up reported by Times of Israel 2026-09-03/05
resolution_notes: Fresh evidence strengthens the chronology but does not cleanly resolve the counterfactual claim. The PMO's own published schedule says Netanyahu was alerted at 06:29 and that the first full situational assessment with the defense minister and senior security chiefs, including the IDF chief, began at 09:55; it also says he received earlier updates through the military secretary and asked about reserve mobilization and targeting at 06:44. Channel 12 separately disputes the PMO's departure/arrival times and reports that he did not call security chiefs before reaching the Kirya. Preserve Pending / Guest: the exact original Channel 14 claim-level clip/timestamp remains unisolated, and the evidence does not directly adjudicate the counterfactual assertion that an earlier wake-up would have prevented the invasion.
